title.en: An Act to Amend Certain Items in Republic Act Numbered Fourteen Hundred Eleven, Regarding Public Works Projects for the Province of Masbate

text.en:
Items (f), (g), (h) and (i), paragraph thirty, page eighty-eight of Republic Act Numbered Fourteen hundred eleven, for the Province of Masbate, are amended to read as follows:
"(f) Placer Municipal Building Construction ₱5,000.00 "(g) Uson Municipal Building Construction ₱5,000.00 "(h) Uson Municipal Building Construction ₱5,000.00 "(i) Uson Municipal Building Construction ₱5,000.00."

Item seven, page two hundred ten of Republic Act Numbered Fourteen hundred eleven, for the Province of Masbate, is amended to read as follows:
""7. Municipal Building, Placer ₱5,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 20, 1957.
